annotations.title: FIRE number and years to it

description: The FIRE number from annual spending and a withdrawal rate, and how many years of saving at a growth rate after inflation reach it, in today's money. Anything not given starts from the person's own figures, as the FIRE page does: the money they could reach before pension age, their saving, their spending and their Settings growth less inflation. Use for 'when could I retire early', 'what is my FIRE number'.

annualContribution.description: Saved each year, in pounds. May be 0. Defaults to the saving Foliopeak holds - usually none outside pensions - plus, with pensions counted, the pension payments on their Retirement overview, in pounds.

annualSpending.description: Spending a year in retirement, today's money, in pounds. Defaults to the spending on their Retirement overview, in pounds, or a year of their Budget's bills.

currentNetWorth.description: Money they could reach and live on before pension age - cash, ISAs they can take money from, general investments, crypto - less cards and loans, in pounds. Not the home or pensions. Defaults to that figure from their accounts.

fireNumber.description: A target set directly, instead of from spending. Optional.

growthRatePct.description: Growth a year after inflation. Defaults to the growth in Settings less its inflation.

includePensions.description: Count pensions and the Lifetime ISA, and pension saving, in the figures taken from their accounts - pensions open at 57 from April 2028, the Lifetime ISA at 60. Defaults to false.
